q: Passport seized no hearing no reason, officer says any order enough, best?
options: Invalid unless fair just reasonable with hearing
expl: Maneka needs fairness; arbitrariness violates liberty.
why: Existence not enough. No reason-hearing shows unfairness.

q: Accused forced by threat to dictate confession, prosecutor relies, correct?
why: Threat makes compelled. Voluntary stands differently.

q: Hut dwellers evicted nights no notice claim shelter, state says breathing only, correct?
options: Life includes dignity-shelter; needs fair process
expl: Life read as dignified living with procedure.
why: Housing law expanded beyond survival. Process matters.

q: AP arrest 8 pm grounds next day produced after 40 hrs excl travel, lawful?
options: Unlawful: prompt grounds plus 24-hr rule broken
why: Both delays unexplained. Gravity no extension.

q: AP preventive hold no grounds month late plea forwarding, effect?
expl: Delay in grounds-plea can invalidate detention.
why: Board beyond 3 months extra. Speed first check.

q: House bans all criticism vaguely for order, SI enforces widely, view?
options: Courts test nexus least invasion; vague fails
expl: Need reasonable link to order; overbroad fails.
why: Review checks purpose-proportion. Vagueness invites abuse.

q: Magistrate grants remand without seeing accused diary, role?
options: Must ensure production need prevent illegal hold
why: Production plus mind mandatory. Diary enables check.

q: Officer says prevention limitless as danger always, correct?
options: Wrong: beyond 3 months Board; plea always
expl: 3-month Board plus plea strictly fence prevention.
why: Exception narrow. Blanket plea no cure.

q: Foreigner tortured told shields only citizens, correct?
options: Wrong: criminal shields cover every person
expl: Triple shield and life cover all persons.
why: Citizenship limits freedoms not shields. Personhood triggers.

q: Speech riot plus arrest no grounds no magistrate plus child denied school, synthesis?
options: Multiple breaches: lawful limit plus grounds-24hrs plus schooling
why: Each separate test. Riot erases none.
